data.name: Sanbra Foods
data.description: Sanbra Foods Ghana is an agricultural services company providing soil testing, precision agriculture, and training to smallholder farmers in Ghana. They are listed as a prospective biochar supplier on Puro.earth but the facility is in early development with a feasibility study ongoing and zero CORCs issued. Biochar CDR is an adjacent activity to their core agricultural consulting business.
